status: proposed; not run; Phase 4 input from packet S1 native half (N1)
target: Ableton Live 12 Suite 12.4.3 (2026-07-07_e3d8be4d07), macOS host only
common_prerequisites: Pin the Live executable and preferences hash before the sitting; fresh preferences with the factory default set template
Retain every input file, its SHA-256, Log.txt, a screen capture of the transport bar and loop brace, and any re-saved file
Disable Link, external sync and tempo follower; no MIDI mappings
